settings.title: Settings
settings.profiles.title: Profiles
settings.profiles.description: Manage your settings profiles to quickly switch between different configurations.
settings.discoveredNodes.title: Discovered Nodes
settings.autoDiscover.description: Mark items you already collected in-game (e.g. effigies) as discovered automatically. Turning this off restores the ones it added.
settings.autoResetRespawned: Reset discovered nodes when they respawn
settings.autoResetRespawned.description: When the in-game app sees a discovered resource node (ore, trees, forage) spawn again, it is marked undiscovered. One-time finds like chests stay discovered.
settings.flashDespawningNodes: Flash nodes that are about to despawn
settings.flashDespawningNodes.descriptio: When the in-game app sees a node's despawn countdown (e.g. Palia ore and forage), its marker flashes like it does in the game: slowly in the last 30 seconds, faster in the last 10.
settings.myFilters.title: My Filters
settings.highContrastMarkers.description: Adds a bright glow around markers for better visibility
settings.positionalAudio.description: Audio alerts get louder as you get closer and repeat while a marker is in range, with the tone panned to the side the marker is on. Made for playing by ear. Off = one alert when something enters range.
settings.traceLine.unsupported: This game does not support trace lines.
settings.rotateMapWithPlayer.description: Turns the map so the direction you are facing is always up, like a rotating minimap. Turns on Follow Player as well.
settings.rotateMapWithCtrlDrag.descripti: Holding Ctrl while dragging rotates and tilts the map. Turn it off if Ctrl is your push-to-talk key: Ctrl + drag then pans like a normal drag. Middle-mouse drag still rotates.
minimap.resizeHint: Drag the corner handles to resize and the round handle to round the corners.
settings.proximityRange.description: Used by audio alerts, "In Range" labels, and "Discover Nearest Node". Configure per-filter using the settings icon next to each filter.
settings.range.description: Distance in map units. The ideal value depends on the game and map scale.
settings.audioAlerts.description: Play a sound when tracked items appear within range. Enable per-filter using the settings icon next to each filter.
settings.showNotification.description: Pop up which alert fired, so you know what dinged.
settings.noAudioAlerts: No audio alerts set. Enable one with the gear icon next to a filter.
settings.alertSound.description: Used by filters that don't have their own tone. Set a tone per filter with the gear icon next to it.
settings.markerLabels.description: Show text labels above markers for easier identification. Configure per-filter using the settings icon next to each filter.
settings.resetInterface.description: Resets all visual settings to defaults
settings.showInteriorNames: Show interior names on the map
settings.showInteriorNames.description: The name next to the layer button of buildings and underground areas. Turn it off for a cleaner map - the button stays, so you can still open their floor maps.
paliaSidebar.weeklyWantsDescription: The progress of the weekly wants is tracked automatically when you are in-game.

xp.title: XP Planner
xp.metaDescription: Plan your {{title}} skills: XP from any level to any level, every training method with XP per action and actions needed, and the materials crafting and building methods cost.
xp.heading: {{title}} XP Planner
xp.intro: Pick a skill, enter your level or exact XP and a target level. You get the XP you still need and how many actions each of the {{methods}} training methods across {{skills}} skills takes. Reaching level {{max}} takes {{xp}} XP. Share your plan with a link.
xp.skillMetaDescription: {{title}} {{skill}} XP calculator: XP from any level to {{max}}, all {{count}} {{skill}} training methods with XP per action and actions needed, material costs and where to train on the map.
xp.skillIntro: {{skill}} has {{count}} training methods in {{title}}. Reaching level {{max}} takes {{xp}} XP. Enter your level and target below to see how many actions each method takes.
xp.loadError: The skill data could not be loaded. Please reload the page.
xp.levelXp: Level {{level}} · {{xp}} XP · {{progress}}% to the next level
xp.noCost: This method has no known material cost.
xp.damageNote: Damage methods give XP per point of damage dealt, so the planner shows the damage you need, not a number of hits.
xp.flag.approx.help: ≈ Calculated from the node's health. The game can round each hit, so the real value can be about 1 XP off.
xp.flag.variable.help: Varies: the base value from the game data. Minigame results, crop yield or the plot tier change the XP you actually get.
xp.flag.min.help: At least: only part of this award is in the game data, so you get this much or more.
xp.flag.unverified.help: Unverified: the game data lists this XP, but players report a different amount.
xp.chopNote: Trees and logs give XP twice: per point of damage while you chop, plus a bonus when the tree falls or a log splits. Add both rows for your real rate.

activities.resetNote: Times in the table are server time. The countdowns above show the next reset in your own time zone.
